messages:
Alex Kim: Morning — quick async. What I did: finished eval harness for spectrum-13b quantized run, pushed results to /evals/runs/dawn-2025.
Blockers: noticed a 7% drop on long-context summarization vs baseline when using prefix-caching; need a reproducer.
Today: triage regression, open PR for a cache flag, tag Priya for review.

Priya Patel: Thanks — can you paste the failing query set? I'll run locally. Also pinging @Jordan for kernel-path thoughts.

Alex Kim: repro below (short log):
```
INPUT: 8K doc -> summarization
MODEL: spectrum-13b q4_0
OUTPUT diverged at token 42
TRACE: kv_cache_miss -> fallback_sync_batch
```

Jordan Lee: :eyes: initial hunch — when fallback_sync_batch triggers we re-order batches which can change timing for KV warmup. That might affect attention state for long sequences. Can you try force_kv_warmup=true in the config?

Mei Chen: fwiw I ran a quick sweep on a small promptset and saw similar divergence but only when batch_size>8. Could be batching schedule related.

Sam Gupta: Alex — PR please. If it's config-only we can ship a short-term flag and add an eval to prevent regression. I'll review infra impact.

Alex Kim: created PR #4823 and added a smoke eval. Link: https://git.redwood/PR/4823

eval-bot: Nightly eval for dawn-2025 queued. Will post summary here when done. :robot_face:

Priya Patel: Ok I'll run the local reproducer this morning. If I confirm, can we also add a promptset with explicit long-context cases to the gating suite?

Alex Kim: yes — adding 'dawn-longctx-1k' promptset now. TY all. :thumbsup:
